name: Management override capability -> fraud risk responses
rationale: Those who design and oversee controls can bypass them, so normal controls provide no protection against override. The rule directs the auditor to the specific responses override requires: targeted journal-entry testing, inquiries of those charged with governance, and evaluation of estimates for bias - while preserving the distinction between opportunity, suspected indicator and confirmed fraud. v2: excludes F-FRP-001 - when unsupported manual journals are also present, the narrower RULE-FRP-002B (priority 5) fires instead, adding the journal-testing battery without duplicating the override procedures.
